title: Gregory Barbaccia disclosed Palantir stock holding
summary: Public financial disclosure lists PLTR stock valued at $1,001–$15,000; disposition and recusal status remain unresolved.

data.instrument: Palantir Technologies Class A common stock (PLTR)
data.methodology: Public OGE Form 278 data indexed by ProPublica.
qualifications: Disclosure reports a value range rather than exact value.
The indexed transaction list displays sales of other technology holdings but does not by itself prove continued ownership of PLTR.
Current divestiture, waiver and recusal status require agency or OGE confirmation.
